title: SEC records: Sara Duterte stayed company director after becoming VP

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Vice President Sara Duterte remained an incorporator and director of a company after assuming office in 2022, according to Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) records presented during her impeachment trial on Monday. SEC Company Registration and Monitoring Department Director Gerardo del Rosario, during Day 27 of the impeachment trial, testified that Duterte owned a 20 percent stake in Metro City Chow Foods Corp. from 2016 to 2025. She was listed as one of the company’s incorporators when it was established in 2016 and served on its board from 2018 to 2025. READ: Sara Duterte’s business interests, gov’t deals face […]...
